<?php

function wpbp_abilities_api_011( string $category ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_abilities' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$names = array();

	foreach ( wp_get_abilities() as $key => $ability ) {
		if ( ! is_object( $ability ) || ! method_exists( $ability, 'get_category' ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( $ability->get_category() !== $category ) {
			continue;
		}

		$name = method_exists( $ability, 'get_name' ) ? $ability->get_name() : $key;
		$names[] = (string) $name;
	}

	$names = array_values( array_unique( $names ) );
	sort( $names, SORT_STRING );

	return $names;
}

function wpbp_abilities_api_012( string $ability_name ): array {
	$result = array(
		'registered'   => false,
		'show_in_rest' => false,
	);

	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_has_ability' ) || ! wp_has_ability( $ability_name ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	$ability = wp_get_ability( $ability_name );

	if ( ! $ability instanceof WP_Ability ) {
		return $result;
	}

	$meta = $ability->get_meta();

	$result['registered']   = true;
	$result['show_in_rest'] = is_array( $meta ) && ! empty( $meta['show_in_rest'] );

	return $result;
}

	/**
	 * Forces meta.show_in_rest to true for abilities whose name starts with 'wpbp-forced/'.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	function wpbp_abilities_api_013(): void {
		add_filter(

			static function ( $args, $ability_name ) {
				if ( ! is_string( $ability_name ) || strpos( $ability_name, 'wpbp-forced/' ) !== 0 ) {

<?php

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_abilities_api_014' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Safely executes a registered ability via the Abilities API.
	 *
	 * @param string $ability_name Registered ability name.
	 * @param mixed  $input        Input passed to the ability.
	 * @return array {
	 *     @type bool   $ok    Whether execution succeeded.
	 *     @type mixed  $value Result on success (present when ok is true).
	 *     @type string $code  Error code on failure (present when ok is false).
	 * }
	 */
	function wpbp_abilities_api_014( string $ability_name, $input ): array {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_ability' ) ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'code' => 'abilities_api_unavailable' );
		}

		try {
			$ability = wp_get_ability( $ability_name );

			if ( ! $ability ) {
				return array( 'ok' => false, 'code' => 'ability_not_found' );
			}

			$result = $ability->execute( $input );
		} catch ( Throwable $e ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'code' => 'ability_exception' );
		}

		if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
			return array(
				'ok'   => false,
				'code' => (string) $result->get_error_code(),
			);
		}

		return array( 'ok' => true, 'value' => $result );
	}
}

	if ( 'wpbp_rating' !== $column ) {
		return;
	}

	$rating = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'wpbp_rating', true );
	echo esc_html( '' !== $rating ? $rating : '' );

<?php

function wpbp_auth_005( int $user_id, string $password ): string {
	global $wpdb;

	$stored_hash = $wpdb->get_var(
		$wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT user_pass FROM {$wpdb->users} WHERE ID = %d",
			$user_id
		)
	);

	if ( ! is_string( $stored_hash ) || '' === $stored_hash ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	// Omit the user ID so core does not perform its own silent upgrade;
	// the rehash is handled explicitly below.
	if ( ! wp_check_password( $password, $stored_hash ) ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	if ( ! wp_password_needs_rehash( $stored_hash ) ) {
		return 'current';
	}

	$new_hash = wp_hash_password( $password );

	$updated = $wpdb->update(
		$wpdb->users,
		array( 'user_pass' => $new_hash ),
		array( 'ID' => $user_id ),
		array( '%s' ),
		array( '%d' )
	);

	if ( false === $updated ) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	clean_user_cache( $user_id );

	return 'rehashed';
}

function wpbp_auth_009( int $user_id, string $token ): bool {
	if ( $user_id <= 0 || $token === '' ) {
		return false;
	}

	$records = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'wpbp_api_tokens', true );

	if ( ! is_array( $records ) || empty( $records ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	foreach ( $records as $record ) {
		if ( ! is_array( $record ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( ! empty( $record['revoked'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( empty( $record['hash'] ) || ! is_string( $record['hash'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		// Passing 0 as the user ID prevents wp_check_password() from attempting
		// a legacy hash upgrade that would modify the user's account password.
		if ( wp_check_password( $token, $record['hash'], 0 ) ) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

<?php

function wpbp_caching_006( array $values, array $keys, string $group, array $salt ): array {
	$current_salt = isset( $salt[0] ) ? (string) $salt[0] : '';
	$stale_salt   = isset( $salt[1] ) ? (string) $salt[1] : '';

	$build_key = static function ( string $salt_value, $key ): string {
		return 'wpbp_' . md5( $salt_value ) . '_' . (string) $key;
	};

	// Store values under the current salt. Each value is wrapped so that
	// cached false values can be told apart from cache misses.
	$to_set = array();
	foreach ( $values as $key => $value ) {
		$to_set[ $build_key( $current_salt, $key ) ] = array( 'v' => $value );
	}

	if ( ! empty( $to_set ) ) {
		wp_cache_set_multiple( $to_set, $group );
	}

	$normalize = static function ( $raw, string $salt_value, array $requested ) use ( $build_key ): array {
		$result = array();
		foreach ( $requested as $key ) {
			$cache_key = $build_key( $salt_value, $key );
			$entry     = ( is_array( $raw ) && array_key_exists( $cache_key, $raw ) ) ? $raw[ $cache_key ] : false;

			if ( is_array( $entry ) && array_key_exists( 'v', $entry ) ) {
				$result[ $key ] = $entry['v'];
			} else {
				$result[ $key ] = false;
			}
		}
		return $result;
	};

	// Current-salt batch read.
	$current_keys = array();
	foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
		$current_keys[] = $build_key( $current_salt, $key );
	}
	$current_raw = ! empty( $current_keys ) ? wp_cache_get_multiple( $current_keys, $group ) : array();

	// Stale-salt batch read.
	$stale_keys = array();
	foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
		$stale_keys[] = $build_key( $stale_salt, $key );
	}
	$stale_raw = ! empty( $stale_keys ) ? wp_cache_get_multiple( $stale_keys, $group ) : array();

	return array(
		'current' => $normalize( $current_raw, $current_salt, $keys ),
		'stale'   => $normalize( $stale_raw, $stale_salt, $keys ),
	);
}

	// Session storage is scoped to $user_id, so other users' sessions are not affected.
	$session_manager = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $user_id );
	$session_manager->destroy_others( $session_token );

	return true;

 * Cancel every scheduled event for the given hook, regardless of the
 * arguments it was scheduled with. Events on other hooks are left intact.
 *

 * @return int The number of events removed.

function wpbp_cron_006( string $hook ): int {
    $removed = 0;

    $crons = _get_cron_array();
    if ( empty( $crons ) || ! is_array( $crons ) ) {
        return 0;
    }

    foreach ( $crons as $timestamp => $hooks ) {
        if ( ! is_array( $hooks ) || ! isset( $hooks[ $hook ] ) || ! is_array( $hooks[ $hook ] ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        foreach ( $hooks[ $hook ] as $event ) {
            $args = isset( $event['args'] ) && is_array( $event['args'] ) ? $event['args'] : array();

            if ( wp_unschedule_event( (int) $timestamp, $hook, $args ) ) {
                $removed++;

        }
    }

}

function wpbp_cron_007( string $hook, array $args ) {
    $crons = _get_cron_array();

    if ( ! is_array( $crons ) || empty( $crons ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    ksort( $crons );
    $key = md5( serialize( $args ) );

    foreach ( $crons as $timestamp => $hooks ) {
        if ( ! is_array( $hooks ) || ! isset( $hooks[ $hook ][ $key ] ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $event = $hooks[ $hook ][ $key ];

        if ( ! isset( $event['args'] ) || $event['args'] !== $args ) {
            continue;
        }

        $schedule = isset( $event['schedule'] ) ? $event['schedule'] : false;
        $interval = 0;

        if ( $schedule ) {
            if ( isset( $event['interval'] ) ) {
                $interval = (int) $event['interval'];
            } else {
                $schedules = wp_get_schedules();
                $interval  = isset( $schedules[ $schedule ]['interval'] ) ? (int) $schedules[ $schedule ]['interval'] : 0;
            }
        }

        return array(
            'timestamp' => (int) $timestamp,
            'schedule'  => $schedule ? $schedule : false,
            'interval'  => $interval,
        );
    }

    return false;
}

<?php

function wpbp_dates_time_001( int $post_id, string $format ): string {
	$post = get_post( $post_id );

	if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
		return '';
	}

	$gmt_date = $post->post_date_gmt;

	if ( empty( $gmt_date ) || '0000-00-00 00:00:00' === $gmt_date ) {
		$local_tz = function_exists( 'wp_timezone' )
			? wp_timezone()
			: new DateTimeZone( get_option( 'timezone_string' ) ?: 'UTC' );

		$moment = new DateTimeImmutable( $post->post_date, $local_tz );
	} else {
		$moment = new DateTimeImmutable( $gmt_date, new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' ) );
	}

	if ( function_exists( 'wp_timezone' ) ) {
		$site_tz = wp_timezone();
	} else {
		$tz_string = get_option( 'timezone_string' );
		if ( $tz_string ) {
			$site_tz = new DateTimeZone( $tz_string );
		} else {
			$offset_hours = (float) get_option( 'gmt_offset', 0 );
			$seconds      = (int) round( $offset_hours * HOUR_IN_SECONDS );
			$sign         = $seconds < 0 ? '-' : '+';
			$seconds      = abs( $seconds );
			$site_tz      = new DateTimeZone( sprintf( '%s%02d:%02d', $sign, intdiv( $seconds, 3600 ), intdiv( $seconds % 3600, 60 ) ) );
		}
	}

	// Converting the instant to the site timezone yields the offset in force at that moment (DST-aware).
	$local = $moment->setTimezone( $site_tz );

	return $local->format( $format ) . ' ' . $local->format( 'P' );
}

<?php

function wpbp_dates_time_002( string $local_datetime ): array {
	if ( function_exists( 'wp_timezone' ) ) {
		$tz = wp_timezone();
	} else {
		$tz_string = get_option( 'timezone_string' );

		if ( ! empty( $tz_string ) ) {
			$tz = new DateTimeZone( $tz_string );
		} else {
			$offset  = (float) get_option( 'gmt_offset', 0 );
			$hours   = (int) $offset;
			$minutes = (int) round( abs( $offset - $hours ) * 60 );
			$tz      = new DateTimeZone( sprintf( '%+03d:%02d', $hours, $minutes ) );
		}
	}

	$local = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $local_datetime, $tz );
	$errors = DateTimeImmutable::getLastErrors();

	if ( false === $local || ( $errors && ( $errors['warning_count'] || $errors['error_count'] ) ) ) {
		throw new InvalidArgumentException( 'Invalid datetime string. Expected format: Y-m-d H:i:s' );
	}

	$utc  = new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' );
	$gmt  = $local->setTimezone( $utc );
	$back = $gmt->setTimezone( $tz );

	return array(
		'gmt'   => $gmt->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ),
		'local' => $back->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ),
	);
}

<?php

function wpbp_dates_time_005( string $utc_datetime ): string {
	$utc  = new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' );
	$date = DateTime::createFromFormat( '!Y-m-d H:i:s', $utc_datetime, $utc );

	if ( false === $date ) {
		throw new InvalidArgumentException( sprintf( 'Invalid UTC datetime string: %s', $utc_datetime ) );
	}

	$timezone_string = get_option( 'timezone_string' );

	if ( is_string( $timezone_string ) && '' !== $timezone_string && in_array( $timezone_string, timezone_identifiers_list(), true ) ) {
		$site_tz = new DateTimeZone( $timezone_string );
	} else {
		// Manual UTC offset in hours (may be fractional, e.g. 5.5, -3.75).
		$gmt_offset    = (float) get_option( 'gmt_offset', 0 );
		$total_seconds = (int) round( $gmt_offset * 3600 );
		$sign          = $total_seconds < 0 ? '-' : '+';
		$abs_seconds   = abs( $total_seconds );
		$hours         = intdiv( $abs_seconds, 3600 );
		$minutes       = intdiv( $abs_seconds % 3600, 60 );
		$site_tz       = new DateTimeZone( sprintf( '%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes ) );
	}

	$date->setTimezone( $site_tz );

	return $date->format( 'c' );
}

/**
 * Returns the first image block found within the first ten block openings.
 *
 * @param string $content Block markup.
 * @return array Parsed image block array, or an empty array if none is found.
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_api_006( string $content ): array {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Block_Processor' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$processor   = new WP_Block_Processor( $content );
	$openings    = 0;
	$image_index = 0;

	while ( $openings < 10 && $processor->next_token() ) {
		if ( $processor->is_block_closer() ) {
			continue;
		}

		++$openings;

		if ( 'core/image' === $processor->get_block_type() ) {
			$image_index = $openings;
			break;
		}
	}

	if ( 0 === $image_index ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Flatten parsed blocks in document order (pre-order), matching opener order.
	$flat = array();
	$walk = function ( array $list ) use ( &$walk, &$flat ) {
		foreach ( $list as $block ) {
			if ( null !== $block['blockName'] ) {
				$flat[] = $block;
			}
			if ( ! empty( $block['innerBlocks'] ) ) {
				$walk( $block['innerBlocks'] );
			}
		}
	};

	$walk( parse_blocks( $content ) );

	$target = $flat[ $image_index - 1 ] ?? null;

	if ( is_array( $target ) && 'core/image' === $target['blockName'] ) {
		return $target;
	}

	return array();
}

function wpbp_block_api_013(): void {
    static $hooked = false;

    $is_wpbp_block = static function ( $name ): bool {
        return is_string( $name ) && 0 === strpos( $name, 'wpbp/' );
    };

    $augment_context = static function ( $context ): array {
        $context = is_array( $context ) ? $context : array();
        if ( ! in_array( 'postId', $context, true ) ) {
            $context[] = 'postId';
        }
        return array_values( array_unique( $context ) );
    };

    $augment_supports = static function ( $supports ): array {
        $supports = is_array( $supports ) ? $supports : array();
        if ( ! isset( $supports['interactivity'] ) || ! is_array( $supports['interactivity'] ) ) {
            $supports['interactivity'] = array();
        }
        $supports['interactivity']['clientNavigation'] = true;
        return $supports;
    };

    // Affects block types registered from block.json from now on.
    if ( ! $hooked ) {
        $hooked = true;
        add_filter(
            'block_type_metadata',
            static function ( $metadata ) use ( $is_wpbp_block, $augment_context, $augment_supports ) {
                if ( ! is_array( $metadata ) || ! $is_wpbp_block( $metadata['name'] ?? null ) ) {
                    return $metadata;
                }
                $metadata['usesContext'] = $augment_context( $metadata['usesContext'] ?? array() );
                $metadata['supports']    = $augment_supports( $metadata['supports'] ?? array() );
                return $metadata;
            },
            10,
            1
        );
    }

    // Affects wpbp block types that were already registered before this ran.
    if ( class_exists( 'WP_Block_Type_Registry' ) ) {
        $registry = WP_Block_Type_Registry::get_instance();
        foreach ( $registry->get_all_registered() as $name => $block_type ) {
            if ( ! $block_type instanceof WP_Block_Type || ! $is_wpbp_block( $name ) ) {

function wpbp_block_api_016( string $document ): string {
	// Matches block delimiter comments (opening, closing and self-closing).
	// Group 1: closing slash, group 2: block name, group 3: JSON attributes, group 4: self-closing slash.
	$pattern = '/<!--\s+(\/)?wp:([a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(?:\/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)?)(?:\s+(\{.*?\}))?\s*(\/)?-->/s';

		return $document;
	}

	$counter = 0;
	$edits   = array();

	foreach ( $matches as $m ) {
		$is_closer = isset( $m[1] ) && $m[1][0] !== '';

		if ( $is_closer ) {
			$depth = max( 0, $depth - 1 );
			continue;
		}

		$is_self_closing = isset( $m[4] ) && $m[4][0] !== '';

		if ( 0 === $depth ) {
			$counter++;

			$name     = $m[2][0];
			$raw_json = ( isset( $m[3] ) && $m[3][0] !== '' ) ? $m[3][0] : '';

			$attrs = '' !== $raw_json ? json_decode( $raw_json ) : null;

			if ( ! isset( $attrs->metadata ) || ! is_object( $attrs->metadata ) ) {
				$attrs->metadata = new stdClass();
			}
			$attrs->metadata->name = 'Section ' . $counter;

			$flags = JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT;
			$json  = function_exists( 'wp_json_encode' )
				? wp_json_encode( $attrs, $flags )

			$edits[] = array(
				'offset'      => $m[0][1],
				'length'      => strlen( $m[0][0] ),
				'replacement' => $replacement,
			);
		}

		if ( ! $is_self_closing ) {
			$depth++;
		}
	}

	// Apply edits from the end of the string so earlier offsets remain valid.
	foreach ( array_reverse( $edits ) as $edit ) {
		$document = substr_replace(
			$document,
			$edit['replacement'],
			$edit['offset'],
			$edit['length']
		);
	}

	return $document;
}

function wpbp_gb_block_bindings_006( int $pattern_id, array $overrides ): string {
	$pattern = get_post( $pattern_id );

		return '';

	// Build the pattern-overrides context keyed by the block's metadata name.
	// Only names explicitly provided are overridden; everything else falls back
	// to the pattern's stored content via the binding's null fallback.
	$pattern_overrides = array();
	foreach ( $overrides as $name => $text ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $name ) || '' === $name ) {
			continue;

		$pattern_overrides[ $name ] = array(

	$context = array(

	);

	$html = '';
	foreach ( parse_blocks( $pattern->post_content ) as $parsed_block ) {
		$block = new WP_Block( $parsed_block, $context );
		$html .= $block->render();
	}

	return $html;
}

function wpbp_gb_interactivity_api_009( array $settings ): array {
	$namespace = 'wpbp/merge';

	$current = wp_interactivity_state( $namespace );
	if ( ! is_array( $current ) ) {
		$current = array();
	}

	// Recursively merge so existing keys (including nested ones under 'settings')
	// survive, while supplied values replace only the keys they specify.
	$merged = array_replace_recursive(
		$current,
		array( 'settings' => $settings )
	);

	$result = wp_interactivity_state( $namespace, $merged );

	return is_array( $result ) ? $result : $merged;
}

function wpbp_hooks_003( callable $callback ): bool {
    $hook     = 'wpbp_remove_filter';

<?php

function wpbp_hooks_008( string $hook, callable $callback, int $new_priority ) {
    global $wp_filter;

    if ( ! isset( $wp_filter[ $hook ] ) || ! ( $wp_filter[ $hook ] instanceof WP_Hook ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    $hook_obj = $wp_filter[ $hook ];

    if ( empty( $hook_obj->callbacks ) || ! is_array( $hook_obj->callbacks ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    $unique_id = _wp_filter_build_unique_id( $hook, $callback, 0 );

    $old_priority = null;
    $entry        = null;

    foreach ( $hook_obj->callbacks as $priority => $callbacks ) {
        if ( isset( $callbacks[ $unique_id ] ) ) {
            $old_priority = (int) $priority;
            $entry        = $callbacks[ $unique_id ];
            break;
        }
    }

    if ( null === $old_priority || null === $entry ) {
        return false;
    }

    if ( $old_priority === $new_priority ) {
        return $old_priority;
    }

    unset( $hook_obj->callbacks[ $old_priority ][ $unique_id ] );

    if ( empty( $hook_obj->callbacks[ $old_priority ] ) ) {
        unset( $hook_obj->callbacks[ $old_priority ] );
    }

    if ( ! isset( $hook_obj->callbacks[ $new_priority ] ) ) {
        $hook_obj->callbacks[ $new_priority ] = array();
    }

    $hook_obj->callbacks[ $new_priority ][ $unique_id ] = $entry;

    ksort( $hook_obj->callbacks, SORT_NUMERIC );

    return $old_priority;
}

<?php
function wpbp_html_api_001( string $html ): string {
	if ( '' === $html || ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Tag_Processor' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	$site_host = wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST );
	if ( ! is_string( $site_host ) || '' === $site_host ) {
		return $html;
	}
	$site_host = strtolower( $site_host );

	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
	$modified  = false;

	while ( $processor->next_tag( array( 'tag_name' => 'A' ) ) ) {
		$href = $processor->get_attribute( 'href' );
		if ( ! is_string( $href ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$href = trim( $href );
		$host = wp_parse_url( $href, PHP_URL_HOST );
		if ( ! is_string( $host ) || '' === $host ) {
			// Root-relative, fragment-only, mailto:, tel:, javascript:, etc.
			continue;
		}

		if ( strtolower( $host ) === $site_host ) {
			continue;
		}

		$rel = $processor->get_attribute( 'rel' );
		if ( is_string( $rel ) && '' !== trim( $rel ) ) {
			$tokens = preg_split( '/[\t\n\f\r ]+/', trim( $rel ), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
			$has    = false;
			foreach ( $tokens as $token ) {
				if ( 'noopener' === strtolower( $token ) ) {
					$has = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if ( $has ) {
				continue;
			}
			$new_rel = implode( ' ', $tokens ) . ' noopener';
		} else {
			$new_rel = 'noopener';
		}

		$processor->set_attribute( 'rel', $new_rel );
		$modified = true;
	}

	if ( ! $modified ) {
		return $html;
	}

	return $processor->get_updated_html();
}

<?php
/**
 * Relabels the first <button> in the supplied markup.
 *
 * The visible text of the first button is replaced with $label, which is
 * treated as plain text and encoded by the HTML API. All other bytes of the
 * document, including the button's attributes and their quoting, are left
 * untouched. Markup without a button is returned unchanged.
 *
 * @param string $html  The markup to process.
 * @param string $label Plain-text replacement label.
 * @return string The updated markup.
 */
function wpbp_html_api_003( string $html, string $label ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html );
	if ( null === $processor ) {
		return $html;
	}

	if ( ! $processor->next_tag( 'BUTTON' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	$found = false;

	while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
		$name = $processor->get_token_name();

		if ( '#text' === $name ) {
			if ( ! $found ) {
				// Plain text: the HTML API performs the encoding.
				$processor->set_modifiable_text( $label );
				$found = true;
			} else {
				// Clear any further text nodes inside the same button.
				$processor->set_modifiable_text( '' );
			}
			continue;
		}

		if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() && 'BUTTON' === $name ) {
			break;
		}
	}

	if ( $found ) {
		return $processor->get_updated_html();
	}

	// The button has no text node to rewrite. Insert the label into the
	// empty button, encoding it as text.
	$updated = $processor->get_updated_html();
	$encoded = htmlspecialchars( $label, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8' );

	$result = preg_replace_callback(
		'#(<button\b[^>]*>)(\s*)(</button\s*>)#i',
		static function ( array $m ) use ( $encoded ): string {
			return $m[1] . $encoded . $m[3];
		},
		$updated,
		1
	);

	return null === $result ? $updated : $result;
}

<?php

function wpbp_html_api_004( string $html ): array {
	$outline = array();

	if ( '' === trim( $html ) ) {
		return $outline;
	}

	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) ) {
		return $outline;
	}

	$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html );
	if ( null === $processor ) {
		return $outline;
	}

	$current = null; // Array with keys: level, id, tag, text.

	$finalize = static function ( array $heading ) use ( &$outline ): void {
		$text = preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', $heading['text'] );
		$outline[] = array(
			'level' => (int) $heading['level'],
			'text'  => trim( (string) $text ),
			'id'    => (string) $heading['id'],
		);
	};

	while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
		$token_type = $processor->get_token_type();

		if ( '#tag' === $token_type ) {
			$tag = strtoupper( (string) $processor->get_tag() );

			if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
				if ( null !== $current && $tag === $current['tag'] ) {
					$finalize( $current );
					$current = null;
				}
			} elseif ( null === $current && preg_match( '/^H([1-6])$/', $tag, $matches ) ) {
				$id = $processor->get_attribute( 'id' );

				$current = array(
					'level' => (int) $matches[1],
					'id'    => is_string( $id ) ? $id : '',
					'tag'   => $tag,
					'text'  => '',
				);
			}
		} elseif ( null !== $current && '#text' === $token_type ) {
			// Text nodes are returned with character references decoded.
			$current['text'] .= (string) $processor->get_modifiable_text();
		}

		// If the parser implicitly closed the open heading (e.g. a new heading
		// started, or an ancestor was closed), finalize it.
		if ( null !== $current ) {
			$open_tags = array_map( 'strtoupper', (array) $processor->get_breadcrumbs() );
			if ( ! in_array( $current['tag'], $open_tags, true ) ) {
				$finalize( $current );
				$current = null;
			}
		}
	}

	// Flush a heading still open at the end of the fragment.
	if ( null !== $current ) {
		$finalize( $current );
	}

	return $outline;
}

<?php
function wpbp_html_api_006( string $html ): string {
	if ( '' === $html || false === stripos( $html, '<figure' ) ) {
		return $html;
	}

	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
	$seq       = 0;

	while ( $processor->next_tag( array( 'tag_name' => 'FIGURE' ) ) ) {
		$seq++;
		$figure_bm = 'wpbp_fig_' . $seq;
		$processor->set_bookmark( $figure_bm );

		$depth         = 1;
		$in_caption    = false;
		$caption_seen  = false;
		$caption_parts = array();
		$image_bms     = array();

		// Walk the figure's extent, collecting caption text and images lacking alt.
		while ( $depth > 0 && $processor->next_token() ) {
			$name = $processor->get_token_name();

			if ( '#text' === $name ) {
				if ( $in_caption ) {
					$caption_parts[] = $processor->get_modifiable_text();
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
				if ( 'FIGURE' === $name ) {
					$depth--;
				} elseif ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $name && $in_caption ) {
					$in_caption = false;
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( 'FIGURE' === $name ) {
				$depth++;
			} elseif ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $name && 1 === $depth && ! $caption_seen ) {
				$caption_seen = true;
				$in_caption   = true;
			} elseif ( 'IMG' === $name && ! $in_caption && null === $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' ) ) {
				$seq++;
				$img_bm = 'wpbp_img_' . $seq;
				$processor->set_bookmark( $img_bm );
				$image_bms[] = $img_bm;
			}
		}

		// Current token is the figure closer (or end of input); remember it.
		$end_bm = 'wpbp_end_' . $seq;
		$processor->set_bookmark( $end_bm );

		$caption = trim( preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', implode( '', $caption_parts ) ) ?? '' );

		if ( '' !== $caption && ! empty( $image_bms ) ) {
			foreach ( $image_bms as $img_bm ) {
				if ( $processor->seek( $img_bm ) ) {
					$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $caption );
				}
				$processor->release_bookmark( $img_bm );
			}
		}

		// Return to the figure end so the outer loop continues after this figure.
		$processor->seek( $end_bm );
		$processor->release_bookmark( $end_bm );
		$processor->release_bookmark( $figure_bm );
	}

	return $processor->get_updated_html();
}

		return '';

	$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html, '<body>' );

/**
 * Sanitizes untrusted HTML by removing the style attribute and every
 * attribute whose name begins with "on" (case-insensitive) from every element.
 * All other attributes, including data-style and data-onclick, are left untouched.
 *
 * Uses the WordPress HTML API (WP_HTML_Tag_Processor) instead of regular expressions.
 *
 * @param string $html Untrusted HTML markup.
 * @return string Sanitized markup.
 */
function wpbp_html_api_008( string $html ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Tag_Processor' ) ) {
		// Fail closed: without the HTML API we cannot safely sanitize.
		return '';
	}

	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );

	while ( $processor->next_tag() ) {
		// Collect the names first so removing attributes does not disturb iteration.
		$names_to_remove = array();

		if ( null !== $processor->get_attribute( 'style' ) ) {
			$names_to_remove[] = 'style';
		}

		$event_names = $processor->get_attribute_names_with_prefix( 'on' );
		if ( is_array( $event_names ) ) {
			foreach ( $event_names as $name ) {
				$names_to_remove[] = $name;
			}
		}

		foreach ( array_unique( $names_to_remove ) as $name ) {
			$processor->remove_attribute( $name );
		}
	}

	return $processor->get_updated_html();
}

<?php
/**
 * Reports whether a raw, undecoded href attribute value would be read by a
 * browser as a javascript: URL.
 *
 * The value is decoded with the WordPress HTML API attribute decoder, then
 * normalized the way the WHATWG URL parser does before reading the scheme:
 * leading and trailing C0 controls and spaces are stripped, and ASCII tab and
 * newline characters are removed everywhere. The scheme is then compared
 * case-insensitively.
 *
 * Hooks are not deferred because the site has already finished booting.
 *
 * @param string $raw_href Raw href attribute text as it appears in the source.
 * @return bool True if the value resolves to a javascript: scheme.
 */
function wpbp_html_api_010( string $raw_href ): bool {
	if ( class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Decoder' ) && method_exists( 'WP_HTML_Decoder', 'decode_attribute' ) ) {
		$decoded = WP_HTML_Decoder::decode_attribute( $raw_href );
	} else {
		// Fallback when the HTML API decoder is unavailable.
		$decoded = html_entity_decode( $raw_href, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8' );
	}

	// Remove ASCII tab and newline characters anywhere in the value.
	$normalized = preg_replace( '/[\t\n\r]/', '', $decoded );

	// Strip leading C0 control characters and spaces.
	$normalized = preg_replace( '/^[\x00-\x20]+/', '', (string) $normalized );

	return 1 === preg_match( '/^javascript:/i', (string) $normalized );
}

function wpbp_http_api_006( string $url ): array {
    $max_attempts = 2;
    $code         = 0;
    $body         = '';

    for ( $attempt = 1; $attempt <= $max_attempts; $attempt++ ) {
        $response = wp_remote_get( $url );

        if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
            // Request failed outright: code stays 0, retry if attempts remain.
            $code = 0;
            $body = '';
            continue;
        }

        $code = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response );
        $body = (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response );

        // Retry only on server errors (>= 500); anything else is final.
        if ( $code < 500 ) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return array(
        'code' => $code,
        'body' => ( 200 === $code ) ? $body : '',
    );
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_media_003' ) ) {

	/**
	 * Calculate WordPress image resize/crop dimensions.
	 *
	 * Wraps WordPress's image_resize_dimensions() from wp-includes/media.php.
	 *
	 * @param int        $orig_w Original image width in pixels.
	 * @param int        $orig_h Original image height in pixels.
	 * @param int        $dest_w Requested destination width in pixels (0 for unconstrained).
	 * @param int        $dest_h Requested destination height in pixels (0 for unconstrained).
	 * @param bool|array $crop   Crop setting. Boolean true for default center crop, or an
	 *                           array of two strings, e.g. [ 'left', 'top' ].
	 * @return array|false Array of 8 values as returned by image_resize_dimensions()
	 *                     [ dst_x, dst_y, src_x, src_y, dst_w, dst_h, src_w, src_h ],
	 *                     or false if the dimensions cannot be calculated.
	 */
	function wpbp_media_003( int $orig_w, int $orig_h, int $dest_w, int $dest_h, bool|array $crop = false ): array|false {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'image_resize_dimensions' ) ) {
			require_once ABSPATH . WPINC . '/media.php';
		}

		$dest_w = max( 0, $dest_w );
		$dest_h = max( 0, $dest_h );

		if ( $orig_w <= 0 || $orig_h <= 0 ) {
			return false;
		}

		if ( 0 === $dest_w && 0 === $dest_h ) {
			return false;
		}

		$dims = image_resize_dimensions( $orig_w, $orig_h, $dest_w, $dest_h, $crop );

		if ( ! is_array( $dims ) ) {
			return false;
		}

		return $dims;
	}
}

function wpbp_post_meta_005( int $post_id, string $meta_key, string $json ): string {
	// Reject input that is not valid JSON so bad data is never stored.
	json_decode( $json );
	if ( json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE ) {
		return '';
	}

	// update_post_meta() passes values through wp_unslash(), which would strip
	// the backslashes from escaped quotes (\"). Slash the value first so it
	// survives unchanged.
	update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, wp_slash( $json ) );

	// Read the value back and confirm it matches what was supplied.
	$stored = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );

	if ( ! is_string( $stored ) || $stored !== $json ) {
		return '';
	}

	return $stored;
}

function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_009( int $post_id, array $submitted_term_ids ): array {
	$taxonomy = 'wpbp_ptt_topic';

	if ( ! taxonomy_exists( $taxonomy ) || ! get_post( $post_id ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$valid_ids = array();

	foreach ( $submitted_term_ids as $raw ) {
		if ( is_int( $raw ) ) {
			$term_id = $raw;
		} elseif ( is_string( $raw ) && ctype_digit( trim( $raw ) ) ) {
			$term_id = (int) trim( $raw );
		} else {
			continue;
		}

		if ( $term_id <= 0 ) {
			continue;
		}

		// Only keep IDs that already exist in this taxonomy; never create terms.
		$term = get_term( $term_id, $taxonomy );
		if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$valid_ids[ $term_id ] = $term_id;
	}

	// Replace (not append) the post's terms with exactly the supplied valid terms.
	wp_set_object_terms( $post_id, array_values( $valid_ids ), $taxonomy, false );

	$current = wp_get_object_terms( $post_id, $taxonomy, array( 'fields' => 'ids' ) );

	if ( is_wp_error( $current ) || ! is_array( $current ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	return array_values( array_map( 'intval', $current ) );
}

function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_011( string $name, int $parent_id ): int {
    $name      = trim( $name );
    $parent_id = max( 0, $parent_id );

    if ( '' === $name ) {
        return 0;
    }

    // Look for an exact name match directly under the given parent.
    $terms = get_terms( array(
        'taxonomy'   => 'category',
        'name'       => $name,
        'parent'     => $parent_id,
        'hide_empty' => false,
        'number'     => 0,
    ) );

    if ( ! is_wp_error( $terms ) && ! empty( $terms ) ) {
        foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
            if ( $term->name === $name && (int) $term->parent === $parent_id ) {
                return (int) $term->term_id;
            }
        }
    }

    // Not found under this parent: create it.
    $result = wp_insert_term( $name, 'category', array( 'parent' => $parent_id ) );

    if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
        if ( 'term_exists' === $result->get_error_code() ) {
            return (int) $result->get_error_data();
        }
        return 0;
    }

    return (int) $result['term_id'];
}

function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_012( int $term_id, int $fallback_term_id ): bool {
	if ( $term_id === $fallback_term_id ) {
		return false;
	}

	$taxonomy = 'category';

	$term     = get_term( $term_id, $taxonomy );
	$fallback = get_term( $fallback_term_id, $taxonomy );

	if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) || ! $fallback || is_wp_error( $fallback ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	// The site's default category cannot be deleted; report failure without touching any posts.
	if ( (int) get_option( 'default_category' ) === $term_id ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Move every post in the retired category to the fallback category,
	// keeping all of its other category assignments intact.
	$object_ids = get_objects_in_term( $term_id, $taxonomy );

	if ( ! is_wp_error( $object_ids ) ) {
		foreach ( array_map( 'intval', (array) $object_ids ) as $object_id ) {
			wp_add_object_terms( $object_id, array( $fallback_term_id ), $taxonomy );
		}
	}

	$result = wp_delete_category( $term_id );

	return true === $result;
}

 * wpbp_pl_genre term IDs. Runs without a logged-in user; no user switching.
 *
 * @param string $title           Post title.
 * @param array  $genre_term_ids  Existing wpbp_pl_genre term IDs.
 * @return int New post ID, or 0 on failure.
 */
function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_002( string $title, array $genre_term_ids ): int {
	$taxonomy = 'wpbp_pl_genre';

	if ( ! taxonomy_exists( $taxonomy ) ) {
		return 0;
	}

	// Normalise and de-duplicate the supplied IDs.
	$term_ids = array_values( array_unique( array_filter(
		array_map( 'intval', $genre_term_ids ),
		static function ( $id ) {
			return $id > 0;
		}
	) ) );

	if ( empty( $term_ids ) ) {
		return 0;
	}

	// Every supplied term must already exist in this taxonomy; never create terms.
	foreach ( $term_ids as $term_id ) {
		$term = get_term( $term_id, $taxonomy );
		if ( ! $term instanceof WP_Term ) {
			return 0;
		}
	}

	// Create the post directly (no user context required, no tax_input,
	// since wp_insert_post's tax_input path checks the current user's capabilities).
	$post_id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_title'  => $title,
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'post_type'   => 'post',
		),
		true
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $post_id ) || ! $post_id ) {
		return 0;
	}

	// wp_set_object_terms performs no capability check, so it works without a user.
	$result = wp_set_object_terms( (int) $post_id, $term_ids, $taxonomy, false );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		wp_delete_post( (int) $post_id, true );
		return 0;
	}

	// Verify that every supplied term ended up on the post.
	$assigned = wp_get_object_terms( (int) $post_id, $taxonomy, array( 'fields' => 'ids' ) );
	if ( is_wp_error( $assigned ) ) {
		wp_delete_post( (int) $post_id, true );
		return 0;
	}

	$assigned = array_map( 'intval', $assigned );
	sort( $assigned );
	$expected = $term_ids;
	sort( $expected );

	if ( $assigned !== $expected ) {
		wp_delete_post( (int) $post_id, true );
		return 0;
	}

	return (int) $post_id;
}

function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_004( int $post_id ): string {
	$post = get_post( $post_id );

	if ( ! $post ) {
		return '';
	}

	// Nothing to restore if the post is not currently in the trash.
	if ( 'trash' !== $post->post_status ) {
		return (string) $post->post_status;
	}

	// Status recorded by WordPress at the moment the post was trashed.
	$previous_status = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_wp_trash_meta_status', true );
	if ( '' === $previous_status || null === $previous_status || false === $previous_status ) {
		$previous_status = 'draft';
	}
	$previous_status = (string) $previous_status;

	// Temporarily override the restore status for this post only.
	// Other restores on the site are unaffected because the filter is removed afterwards.
	$status_filter = static function ( $new_status, $id, $prev ) use ( $post_id, $previous_status ) {
		if ( (int) $id === (int) $post_id ) {
			return $previous_status;
		}
		return $new_status;
	};

	add_filter( 'wp_untrash_post_status', $status_filter, 10, 3 );

	wp_untrash_post( $post_id );

	remove_filter( 'wp_untrash_post_status', $status_filter, 10 );

	// Fallback for WordPress versions without the wp_untrash_post_status filter.
	$current_status = get_post_status( $post_id );
	if ( $current_status !== $previous_status && 'trash' !== $previous_status ) {
		wp_update_post( array(
			'ID'          => $post_id,
			'post_status' => $previous_status,
		) );
	}

	return (string) get_post_status( $post_id );
}

/**
 * Make the 'wpbp_pl_subtitle' post meta part of post revision history.
 * Registrations and hooks are attached immediately, since WordPress has already booted.
 */

// 1. Register the meta key for posts as a single string.
register_post_meta(
    'post',
    'wpbp_pl_subtitle',
    array(
        'type'              => 'string',
        'single'            => true,
        'show_in_rest'      => true,
        'revisions_enabled' => true,
        'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
        'auth_callback'     => static function ( $allowed, $meta_key, $post_id ) {
            return current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id );
        },
    )
);

// 2. Sync the submitted subtitle onto the post before core decides whether to create a revision.
add_action(
    'pre_post_update',
    static function ( $post_id, $data = array() ) {
        if ( ! isset( $_POST['wpbp_pl_subtitle'] ) ) {
            return;
        }
        if ( wp_is_post_revision( $post_id ) || wp_is_post_autosave( $post_id ) ) {
            return;
        }
        if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id ) ) {
            return;
        }
        $subtitle = sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['wpbp_pl_subtitle'] ) );
        update_post_meta( $post_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle', $subtitle );
    },
    1,
    2
);

// 3. Treat a subtitle change as a change to the post, so a revision is created even if the post columns are unchanged.
add_filter(
    'wp_save_post_revision_post_has_changed',
    static function ( $post_has_changed, $last_revision, $post ) {
        if ( $post_has_changed ) {
            return true;
        }
        if ( ! $last_revision instanceof WP_Post ) {
            return $post_has_changed;
        }
        $current = (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle', true );
        $previous = (string) get_post_meta( $last_revision->ID, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle', true );

        return $current !== $previous ? true : $post_has_changed;
    },
    10,
    3
);

// 4. Copy the subtitle into each newly created revision so it carries the value it was saved with.
add_action(
    '_wp_put_post_revision',
    static function ( $revision_id ) {
        $revision = get_post( $revision_id );
        if ( ! $revision || ! $revision->post_parent ) {
            return;
        }
        $parent_id = (int) $revision->post_parent;
        if ( metadata_exists( 'post', $parent_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle' ) ) {
            update_metadata(
                'post',
                $revision_id,
                'wpbp_pl_subtitle',
                get_post_meta( $parent_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle', true )
            );
        } else {
            delete_metadata( 'post', $revision_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle' );
        }
    },
    10,
    1
);

add_action(
    'wp_restore_post_revision',
    static function ( $post_id, $revision_id ) {
        if ( metadata_exists( 'post', $revision_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle' ) ) {
            update_post_meta(
                $post_id,
                'wpbp_pl_subtitle',
                get_post_meta( $revision_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle', true )
            );
        } else {
            delete_post_meta( $post_id, 'wpbp_pl_subtitle' );
        }
    },

<?php

function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_009( int $post_id, bool $permanently ): bool {
    if ( $post_id <= 0 ) {
        return false;
    }

    if ( $permanently ) {
        // Deletes the post row and all of its metadata.
        $result = wp_delete_post( $post_id, true );
        return (bool) $result;
    }

    // Already in the Trash: nothing more to do, metadata is intact.
    if ( get_post_status( $post_id ) === 'trash' ) {
        return true;
    }

    // With trash disabled, wp_trash_post() would delete permanently.
    // Refuse rather than remove data the caller asked to keep recoverable.
    if ( defined( 'EMPTY_TRASH_DAYS' ) && (int) EMPTY_TRASH_DAYS === 0 ) {
        return false;
    }

    // Moves the post to the Trash and keeps its metadata for restoration.
    $result = wp_trash_post( $post_id );

    return (bool) $result;
}

function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_010( string $path, string $post_type ): int {
	$segments = array_values(
		array_filter(
			array_map( 'sanitize_title', explode( '/', trim( $path, '/' ) ) ),
			'strlen'
		)
	);

	if ( empty( $segments ) || '' === $post_type ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$leaf = end( $segments );

	$candidates = get_posts(
		array(
			'name'           => $leaf,
			'post_type'      => $post_type,
			'post_status'    => 'any',
			'posts_per_page' => -1,
			'fields'         => 'ids',
			'orderby'        => 'ID',
			'order'          => 'ASC',
			'no_found_rows'  => true,
		)
	);

	foreach ( $candidates as $candidate_id ) {
		$current = get_post( (int) $candidate_id );
		$matched = true;

		for ( $i = count( $segments ) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
			if ( ! $current || $current->post_name !== $segments[ $i ] ) {
				$matched = false;
				break;
			}

			if ( 0 === $i ) {
				// The first segment must be a root-level post.
				if ( (int) $current->post_parent !== 0 ) {
					$matched = false;
				}
				break;
			}

			$current = get_post( (int) $current->post_parent );
		}

		if ( $matched ) {
			return (int) $candidate_id;
		}
	}

	return 0;
}

function wpbp_handle_booking_request( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
	$room   = $request->get_param( 'room' );
	$guests = (int) $request->get_param( 'guests' );

	$booked = get_option( 'wpbp_bookings', array() );
	if ( ! is_array( $booked ) ) {
		$booked = array();
	}

	$errors = array();

	if ( in_array( $room, $booked, true ) ) {
		$errors[] = array(
			'code'    => 'wpbp_room_taken',
			'message' => sprintf( 'The room "%s" is already booked.', $room ),
		);
	}

	if ( $guests > 4 ) {
		$errors[] = array(
			'code'    => 'wpbp_over_capacity',
			'message' => sprintf( 'A room holds at most 4 guests; %d were requested.', $guests ),
		);
	}

	if ( ! empty( $errors ) ) {
		$codes  = wp_list_pluck( $errors, 'code' );
		$status = in_array( 'wpbp_room_taken', $codes, true ) ? 409 : 400;

		return new WP_REST_Response(
			array(
				'code'    => 'wpbp_booking_failed',
				'message' => implode( ' ', wp_list_pluck( $errors, 'message' ) ),
				'data'    => array(
					'status' => $status,
					'errors' => $errors,
				),
			),
			$status
		);
	}

	$booked[] = $room;
	update_option( 'wpbp_bookings', $booked );

	return new WP_REST_Response(
		array(
			'room'   => $room,
			'guests' => $guests,
		),
		201
	);
}

function wpbp_register_booking_route() {
	register_rest_route(
		'wpbp/v1',
		'/bookings',
		array(

					'type'     => 'string',
					'enum'     => array( 'harbor', 'cedar' ),
				),
				'guests' => array(
					'type'    => 'integer',
					'default' => 2,
					'minimum' => 1,
				),
			),
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Parse the _fields request parameter into a list of field names.
 * An empty result means no field filter was supplied.
 */
function wpbp_parse_report_fields( WP_REST_Request $request ): array {
    $raw = $request->get_param( '_fields' );

    if ( null === $raw || '' === $raw || is_array( $raw ) && empty( $raw ) ) {
        return array();
    }

    if ( is_array( $raw ) ) {
        $raw = implode( ',', $raw );
    }

    $fields = array_filter( array_map( 'trim', explode( ',', (string) $raw ) ), 'strlen' );

    return array_values( array_unique( $fields ) );
}

/**
 * Route callback for GET /wpbp/v1/reports/<id>.
 */
function wpbp_get_report_route_callback( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
    $id      = absint( $request['id'] );
    $reports = get_option( 'wpbp_reports', array() );

    if ( ! is_array( $reports ) || ! array_key_exists( $id, $reports ) ) {
        return new WP_Error(
            'wpbp_report_not_found',
            __( 'Report not found.', 'wpbp' ),
            array( 'status' => 404 )
        );
    }

    $requested = wpbp_parse_report_fields( $request );
    $all       = empty( $requested );
    $data      = array();

    if ( $all || in_array( 'id', $requested, true ) ) {
        $data['id'] = $id;
    }

    if ( $all || in_array( 'title', $requested, true ) ) {
        $data['title'] = $reports[ $id ];
    }

    // The expensive helper runs only when stats was explicitly requested
    // or no field filter was supplied at all.
    if ( $all || in_array( 'stats', $requested, true ) ) {
        $data['stats'] = wpbp_report_stats( $id );
    }

    return rest_ensure_response( $data );
}

/**
 * Registers the wpbp/v1 report route.
 */
function wpbp_register_report_route(): void {
    register_rest_route(
        'wpbp/v1',
        '/reports/(?P<id>\d+)',
        array(
            'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
            'callback'            => 'wpbp_get_report_route_callback',
            'permission_callback' => static function () {
                return current_user_can( 'manage_options' );
            },
            'args'                => array(
                'id' => array(
                    'required'          => true,
                    'validate_callback' => static function ( $value ) {
                        return is_numeric( $value );
                    },
                    'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
                ),
            ),
        )
    );
}

// rest_api_init has normally already fired at this point, so register directly.
// Otherwise, attach to it so the route is registered when the REST server boots.
if ( did_action( 'rest_api_init' ) ) {
    wpbp_register_report_route();
} else {
    add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'wpbp_register_report_route' );
}

<?php
/**
 * WPBP shared-secret REST authentication.
 *
 * Runs during the REST API authentication phase via rest_authentication_errors.
 * Attached directly because the site has already finished booting.
 */
add_filter(
	'rest_authentication_errors',
	static function ( $result ) {
		// Another authentication method already produced a result (success or error).
		if ( null !== $result ) {
			return $result;
		}

		// No header supplied: leave the request exactly as WordPress found it.
		if ( ! isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_WPBP_KEY'] ) ) {
			return $result;
		}

		$provided = (string) wp_unslash( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_WPBP_KEY'] );
		$expected = (string) get_option( 'wpbp_api_key', '' );

		// Fail closed if no secret is configured or the header does not match.
		if ( '' === $expected || ! hash_equals( $expected, $provided ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'wpbp_bad_key',
				__( 'Invalid API key.', 'default' ),
				array( 'status' => 401 )
			);
		}

		$user_id = (int) get_option( 'wpbp_api_user', 0 );
		if ( $user_id <= 0 ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'wpbp_bad_key',
				__( 'API user is not configured.', 'default' ),
				array( 'status' => 401 )
			);
		}

		wp_set_current_user( $user_id );

		return true;
	},
	101
);

/**
 * Build request arguments from the item schema.
 *
 * @param bool $for_create True for POST (create rules: required fields and defaults),
 *                         false for edits (no required fields, no defaults).
 * @return array
 */
function wpbp_widget_args( $for_create ) {
	$schema   = wpbp_widget_item_schema();
	$required = isset( $schema['required'] ) ? (array) $schema['required'] : [];
	$args     = [];

	foreach ( $schema['properties'] as $field => $prop ) {
		if ( ! empty( $prop['readonly'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$arg = [
			'type'        => $prop['type'],
			'description' => isset( $prop['description'] ) ? $prop['description'] : '',
		];

		if ( 'string' === $prop['type'] ) {
			$arg['sanitize_callback'] = 'sanitize_text_field';
		}
		if ( isset( $prop['enum'] ) ) {
			$arg['enum'] = $prop['enum'];
		}
		if ( isset( $prop['minLength'] ) ) {
			$arg['minLength'] = $prop['minLength'];
		}
		if ( $for_create ) {
			if ( array_key_exists( 'default', $prop ) ) {
				$arg['default'] = $prop['default'];
			}
			if ( in_array( $field, $required, true ) ) {
				$arg['required'] = true;
			}
		}

		$args[ $field ] = $arg;
	}

	return $args;
}

function wpbp_widgets_can_write() {
	return current_user_can( 'manage_options' );
}

function wpbp_widgets_get() {
	$widgets = get_option( 'wpbp_widgets', [] );
	return is_array( $widgets ) ? $widgets : [];
}

function wpbp_widgets_save( array $widgets ) {
	update_option( 'wpbp_widgets', $widgets, false );
}

function wpbp_widgets_format( array $record ) {
	return [
		'id'     => (int) $record['id'],
		'name'   => (string) $record['name'],
		'colour' => (string) $record['colour'],
	];
}

function wpbp_widgets_create( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
	$widgets = wpbp_widgets_get();
	$id      = $widgets ? (int) max( array_keys( $widgets ) ) + 1 : 1;

	$colour = $request->has_param( 'colour' ) ? $request->get_param( 'colour' ) : null;

	$record = [
		'id'     => $id,
		'name'   => $request->get_param( 'name' ),
		'colour' => null !== $colour ? $colour : 'blue',
	];

	$widgets[ $id ] = $record;
	wpbp_widgets_save( $widgets );

	$response = new WP_REST_Response( wpbp_widgets_format( $record ), 201 );
	$response->header( 'Location', rest_url( 'wpbp/v1/widgets/' . $id ) );

	return $response;
}

function wpbp_widgets_update( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
	$id      = (int) $request->get_param( 'id' );
	$widgets = wpbp_widgets_get();

	if ( ! isset( $widgets[ $id ] ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_widget_not_found',
			__( 'Widget not found.', 'wpbp' ),
			[ 'status' => 404 ]
		);
	}

	$record = $widgets[ $id ];

	foreach ( [ 'name', 'colour' ] as $field ) {
		if ( $request->has_param( $field ) ) {
			$value = $request->get_param( $field );
			if ( null !== $value ) {
				$record[ $field ] = $value;
			}
		}
	}

	$widgets[ $id ] = $record;
	wpbp_widgets_save( $widgets );

	return new WP_REST_Response( wpbp_widgets_format( $record ), 200 );
}

    add_rewrite_tag( '%wpbp_item%', '([^/]+)', 'wpbp_item=' );

    if ( ! in_array( 'wpbp_item', (array) $wp->public_query_vars, true ) ) {

        'wpbp_item',

<?php

if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_roles_caps_009' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Returns the IDs of all users who hold the given capability, either through
	 * a role that includes it or through a direct grant on the user.
	 *
	 * @param string $capability Capability name to look up.
	 * @return int[] User IDs holding the capability. Empty array if none.
	 */
	function wpbp_roles_caps_009( string $capability ): array {
		global $wpdb;

		$capability = trim( $capability );
		if ( '' === $capability ) {
			return array();
		}

		$candidate_ids = array();

		// 1. Users whose role includes the capability.
		$roles_with_cap = array();
		$wp_roles       = wp_roles();
		foreach ( array_keys( $wp_roles->roles ) as $role_name ) {
			$role = get_role( $role_name );
			if ( $role && ! empty( $role->capabilities[ $capability ] ) ) {
				$roles_with_cap[] = $role_name;
			}
		}

		if ( ! empty( $roles_with_cap ) ) {
			$role_user_ids = get_users(
				array(
					'role__in' => $roles_with_cap,
					'fields'   => 'ID',
				)
			);
			$candidate_ids = array_merge( $candidate_ids, $role_user_ids );
		}

		// 2. Users with the capability granted directly (stored in the capabilities usermeta).
		$direct_user_ids = get_users(
			array(
				'meta_key'     => $wpdb->prefix . 'capabilities',
				'meta_value'   => '"' . $wpdb->esc_like( $capability ) . '"',
				'meta_compare' => 'LIKE',
				'fields'       => 'ID',
			)
		);
		$candidate_ids = array_merge( $candidate_ids, $direct_user_ids );

		// 3. Verify each candidate actually holds the capability (honours explicit denials).
		$candidate_ids = array_unique( array_map( 'intval', $candidate_ids ) );
		$result        = array();

		foreach ( $candidate_ids as $user_id ) {
			$user = get_userdata( $user_id );
			if ( $user && $user->has_cap( $capability ) ) {
				$result[] = (int) $user_id;
			}
		}

		return array_values( $result );
	}
}

/**
 * Escapes a URL for HTML display, preferring HTTPS when a scheme is missing.
 *
 * @param string $url The raw URL to escape.
 * @return string The escaped URL, or an empty string if it is invalid or uses a disallowed scheme.
 */
function wpbp_security_005( string $url ): string {
	$url = trim( $url );

	if ( '' === $url ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( 0 === strpos( $url, '//' ) ) {
		// Protocol-relative URL: force HTTPS instead of esc_url()'s default HTTP.
		$url = 'https:' . $url;
	} elseif ( ! preg_match( '#^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*:#i', $url ) ) {
		// No scheme present: prepend HTTPS so esc_url() does not default to HTTP.
		$url = 'https://' . $url;
	}

	// Allow both HTTP and HTTPS; esc_url() returns an empty string for anything else.
	return esc_url( $url, array( 'http', 'https' ) );
}

/**
 * Sanitises editor-supplied HTML for the newsletter panel.
 *
 * Keeps everything WordPress permits in post content (including data-*
 * attributes), adds a <wpbp-badge label="..."> element, and allows the
 * internal wpbp: scheme for href values. javascript: and other unsafe
 * protocols, event handler attributes and script tags are still removed.
 *
 * @param string $html Raw editor HTML.
 * @return string Sanitised HTML.
 */
function wpbp_security_010( string $html ): string {
    // Start from the WordPress post-content allow-list.
    $allowed = wp_kses_allowed_html( 'post' );

    // Permit data-* attributes (analytics hooks) on every allowed element.
    foreach ( $allowed as $tag => $attributes ) {
        if ( ! is_array( $attributes ) ) {
            continue;
        }
        $attributes['data-*'] = true;
        $allowed[ $tag ]      = $attributes;
    }

    // Add the custom badge element with its label attribute.
    $allowed['wpbp-badge'] = array(
        'label'  => true,
        'data-*' => true,
    );

    // Start from the standard allowed protocols (javascript: is not among them)
    // and add the internal wpbp scheme. Other protocol checks are unchanged.
    $protocols   = wp_allowed_protocols();
    $protocols[] = 'wpbp';
    $protocols   = array_values( array_unique( $protocols ) );

    return wp_kses( $html, $allowed, $protocols );
}

<?php

function wpbp_settings_options_006( string $code ): ?bool {
	$key    = 'wpbp_stock_' . $code;
	$cached = get_transient( $key );

	// The value is wrapped in an array so that a cached null or false
	// is distinguishable from a missing transient (which returns false).
	if ( is_array( $cached ) && array_key_exists( 'state', $cached ) ) {
		return $cached['state'];
	}

	$raw = wpbp_stock_lookup_source( $code );

	// Normalise to the three-state contract: true, false or null.
	if ( true === $raw ) {
		$state = true;
	} elseif ( false === $raw ) {
		$state = false;
	} else {
		$state = null;
	}

	set_transient( $key, array( 'state' => $state ), 5 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );

	return $state;
}

<?php

function wpbp_settings_options_007( array $autoload_map ): array {
	global $wpdb;

	$result = array();

	if ( empty( $autoload_map ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	$names = array();
	foreach ( array_keys( $autoload_map ) as $key ) {
		$names[] = (string) $key;
	}

	$placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $names ), '%s' ) );

	// Query 1: read the current autoload values for every requested option in one pass.
	$rows = $wpdb->get_results(
		$wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT option_name, autoload FROM {$wpdb->options} WHERE option_name IN ($placeholders)",
			$names
		)
	);

	$current = array();
	if ( is_array( $rows ) ) {
		foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
			$current[ (string) $row->option_name ] = (string) $row->autoload;
		}
	}

	$to_on  = array();
	$to_off = array();

	foreach ( $autoload_map as $key => $want ) {
		$name = (string) $key;
		$want = (bool) $want;

		$result[ $name ] = false;

		// Option does not exist: nothing to change.
		if ( ! array_key_exists( $name, $current ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$is_on = in_array( $current[ $name ], array( 'yes', 'auto-on' ), true );

		// Already correct: no change needed.
		if ( $is_on === $want ) {
			continue;
		}

		$result[ $name ] = true;

		if ( $want ) {
			$to_on[] = $name;
		} else {
			$to_off[] = $name;
		}
	}

	$changed = array_merge( $to_on, $to_off );

	// Queries 2 and 3: at most one UPDATE per desired flag value.
	if ( ! empty( $to_on ) ) {
		$in = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $to_on ), '%s' ) );
		$wpdb->query(
			$wpdb->prepare(
				"UPDATE {$wpdb->options} SET autoload = %s WHERE option_name IN ($in)",
				array_merge( array( 'yes' ), $to_on )
			)
		);
	}

	if ( ! empty( $to_off ) ) {
		$in = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $to_off ), '%s' ) );
		$wpdb->query(
			$wpdb->prepare(
				"UPDATE {$wpdb->options} SET autoload = %s WHERE option_name IN ($in)",
				array_merge( array( 'no' ), $to_off )
			)
		);
	}

	// Invalidate caches so subsequent reads reflect the new autoload state.
	if ( ! empty( $changed ) ) {
		wp_cache_delete( 'alloptions', 'options' );
		wp_cache_delete( 'notoptions', 'options' );
		foreach ( $changed as $name ) {
			wp_cache_delete( $name, 'options' );
		}
	}

	return $result;
}

<?php
function wpbp_settings_options_009( array $option_names ): array {
	global $wpdb;

	// Normalise and de-duplicate the requested names.
	$names = array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'strval', $option_names ) ) );

	// Start every requested option as false; stored values will overwrite these.
	$result = array_fill_keys( $names, false );

	if ( empty( $names ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	// Build one prepared IN (...) query for the whole list.
	$placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $names ), '%s' ) );
	$sql          = "SELECT option_name, option_value FROM {$wpdb->options} WHERE option_name IN ($placeholders)";
	$prepared     = $wpdb->prepare( $sql, ...$names );

	$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $prepared, ARRAY_A );

	if ( is_array( $rows ) ) {
		foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
			$result[ $row['option_name'] ] = maybe_unserialize( $row['option_value'] );
		}
	}

	return $result;
}

<?php
/**
 * Saves a value to a named option and reports what happened.
 *
 * @param string $option Option name.
 * @param mixed  $value  Value to store.
 * @return string 'created', 'updated' or 'unchanged'.
 */
function wpbp_settings_options_010( string $option, $value ): string {
    // Unique sentinel so that stored '' or '0' still count as existing.
    $sentinel = new stdClass();

    $current = get_option( $option, $sentinel );

    if ( $current === $sentinel ) {
        if ( add_option( $option, $value ) ) {
            return 'created';
        }
        // add_option() failed, so the option now exists (e.g. created concurrently).
        $current = get_option( $option, $sentinel );
    }

    if ( $current !== $sentinel && maybe_serialize( $current ) === maybe_serialize( $value ) ) {
        return 'unchanged';
    }

    update_option( $option, $value );

    return 'updated';
}

<?php
/**
 * Reports whether the supplied content contains the supplied registered shortcode tag,
 * including occurrences nested inside other shortcodes. The shortcode is never rendered.
 *
 * @param string $content Content to inspect.
 * @param string $tag     Shortcode tag name to look for.
 * @return bool True if a registered, non-escaped instance of the tag is present, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_shortcodes_004( string $content, string $tag ): bool {
    $tag = trim( $tag );

    if ( '' === $tag || '' === $content ) {
        return false;
    }

    if ( ! shortcode_exists( $tag ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    if ( false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    // Build the WordPress shortcode regex limited to this tag. The regex is applied
    // as a scan, so occurrences nested inside other shortcodes' content are also matched.
    $pattern = get_shortcode_regex( array( $tag ) );

    if ( ! preg_match_all( '/' . $pattern . '/s', $content, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER ) ) {
        return false;
    }

    foreach ( $matches as $match ) {
        // Group 1 is the extra '[' used for escaped shortcodes like [[tag]]; those are not rendered.
        if ( '[' === $match[1] ) {
            continue;
        }

        if ( isset( $match[2] ) && $tag === $match[2] ) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

<?php
/**
 * Resolve which block template WordPress would actually use for a template slug.
 *
 * Walks the block template hierarchy derived from the supplied slug and returns
 * the first template that exists, either as a theme file or as a site-editor
 * customization stored in the database. Falls back to 'index'.
 *
 * @param string $template_slug Template slug, e.g. 'single-post-hello', 'category-news', 'page-about'.
 * @return string The slug of the template the site would use.
 */
function wpbp_theme_templates_002( string $template_slug ): string {
	static $existing = null;

	// Build a lookup of every wp_template slug that exists (theme files and DB customizations).
	// get_block_templates() merges both sources, so this covers either origin.
	if ( null === $existing ) {
		$existing = array();

		if ( function_exists( 'get_block_templates' ) ) {
			$templates = get_block_templates( array(), 'wp_template' );

			foreach ( (array) $templates as $template ) {
				if ( ! empty( $template->slug ) ) {
					$existing[ $template->slug ] = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Normalize the incoming slug to safe template-slug characters.
	$slug = strtolower( preg_replace( '/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '', $template_slug ) );

	if ( '' === $slug ) {
		return 'index';
	}

	// Generic parent relationships in the block template hierarchy.
	// Keys are template prefixes, values are the parent template they fall back to.
	$parents = array(
		'front-page' => 'home',
		'home'       => 'index',
		'single'     => 'singular',
		'page'       => 'singular',
		'category'   => 'archive',
		'tag'        => 'archive',
		'author'     => 'archive',
		'date'       => 'archive',
		'taxonomy'   => 'archive',
		'archive'    => 'index',
		'search'     => 'index',
		'404'        => 'index',
	);

	// Derive the specific-to-generic prefixes from the slug itself.
	// e.g. 'single-post-hello' => 'single-post-hello', 'single-post', 'single'.
	$segments = explode( '-', $slug );
	$chain    = array();

	for ( $i = count( $segments ); $i >= 1; $i-- ) {
		$prefix  = implode( '-', array_slice( $segments, 0, $i ) );
		$chain[] = $prefix;

		// Insert the mapped parent immediately after the prefix it belongs to.
		if ( isset( $parents[ $prefix ] ) ) {
			$chain[] = $parents[ $prefix ];
		}
	}

	$chain[] = 'index';

	// Remove duplicates while preserving order.
	$chain = array_values( array_unique( $chain ) );

	foreach ( $chain as $candidate ) {
		if ( isset( $existing[ $candidate ] ) ) {
			return $candidate;
		}
	}

	return 'index';
}

<?php

function wpbp_theme_templates_007( array $block_styles ): array {
	$empty = array(
		'css'        => '',
		'classnames' => '',
	);

	if ( empty( $block_styles ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_style_engine_get_styles' ) ) {
		return $empty;
	}

	$result = wp_style_engine_get_styles(
		$block_styles,
		array(
			'convert_vars_to_classnames' => true,
		)
	);

	if ( ! is_array( $result ) ) {
		return $empty;
	}

	$css = isset( $result['css'] ) && is_string( $result['css'] ) ? trim( $result['css'] ) : '';

	$classnames = '';
	if ( ! empty( $result['classnames'] ) ) {
		$raw_classes = is_array( $result['classnames'] )
			? implode( ' ', $result['classnames'] )
			: (string) $result['classnames'];

		$classes    = preg_split( '/\s+/', trim( $raw_classes ), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
		$classes    = array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'sanitize_html_class', (array) $classes ) ) );
		$classnames = implode( ' ', array_filter( $classes ) );
	}

	return array(
		'css'        => $css,
		'classnames' => $classnames,
	);
}
